text_block_list.text:
The crowd at the Yasuda Kinen is even
more riled
up than usual. They're
expecting a lot from Fuji
Kiseki.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She meets her fans' cheers with a
gracious smile,
but Хиши Амадзон notices
there's something off
about her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
